source.text: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַלְמ֥וּת לַבֵּ֗ן מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: For the director, on Muth-labben. A psalm of David.

en.L: For the director: on Muth-labben. A psalm of David.
en.B: For the music director. On Muth-labben. A psalm of David.
en.R: For the leader of the music. Set to the tune "Muth-labben". A song of David.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur : sur Mouth-labben. Un psaume de David.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. Sur Mouth-labben. Un psaume de David.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. Sur l’air « Mouth-labben ». Un chant de David.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya: kwa Muth-labeni. Zaburi ya Daudi.
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Kwa Muth-labeni. Zaburi ya Daudi.
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Kwa sauti ya wimbo "Muth-labeni". Wimbo wa Daudi.

es.L: Al director del coro: sobre Mut-labén. Salmo de David.
es.B: Al director del coro. Sobre Mut-labén. Salmo de David.
es.R: Para el director de la música. Con la melodía «Mut-labén». Canto de David.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 3, the title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: Muth-labben: "death of the son", probably a tune
alternatives: for young women's voices (alamoth), for Ben
the secrets of the son (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The words ('almut labben) read "on the death of the son". They may name a tune; some read the first word as alamoth (1 Chronicles 15:20), a musical term. The ancient Greek translation has "for the secrets of the son". The sense is no longer known.

decisions.choice: Psalms 9 and 10: one alphabet poem
decisions.reason: Psalms 9 and 10 together form an acrostic: the lines begin, in pairs, with the letters of the Hebrew alphabet in order, though some letters are missing. Psalm 10 has no title, and the ancient Greek and Latin translations count the two as one psalm, so their numbers differ from here to Psalm 147.

decisions.choice: song
decisions.reason: As in 3:1.

decisions.choice: "Mouth-labben" kept as a name, spelled with "ou"
decisions.reason: The words seem to mean "death of the son", probably the name of a tune (m3). French keeps the name as the English does, with "ou" so that it is read as in Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "Muth-labeni" kept as a name; at Readable, "kwa sauti ya wimbo" (to the tune of the song)
alternatives: translating it as "kifo cha mwana" (death of the son)
decisions.reason: The words seem to mean "death of the son", probably the name of a tune (m3). Swahili keeps the name, as the English does; Readable says it is a tune, following the English Readable.

decisions.choice: Mut-labén
decisions.reason: The Hebrew words mean "death of the son" and probably name a tune now lost. Spanish keeps them as a name, as the English does, and Readable says it is a tune.

source.text: אוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־לִבִּ֑י אֲ֝סַפְּרָ֗ה כָּל־נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: I will give thanks to YHWH with all my heart; I will recount all your wonders.

en.L: I will give thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with all my heart; I will recount all {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wonders.
en.B: I will thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with my whole heart; I will tell of all the wonderful things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done.
en.R: I will thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with all my heart. I will tell about all the amazing things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done.

fr.L: Je rendrai grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} de tout mon cœur ; je ferai le récit de toutes {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} merveilles.
fr.B: Je remercierai {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} de tout mon cœur ; je dirai toutes les merveilles que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faites.
fr.R: Je remercierai {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} de tout mon cœur. Je parlerai de toutes les choses extraordinaires que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faites.

sw.L: Nitamshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa moyo wangu wote; nitasimulia maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yote.
sw.B: Nitamshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa moyo wangu wote; nitasimulia mambo yote ya ajabu uliyoyatenda.
sw.R: Nitamshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa moyo wangu wote. Nitawaambia watu mambo yote ya ajabu uliyoyafanya.

es.L: Daré gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con todo mi corazón; contaré todas {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} maravillas.
es.B: Daré gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} de todo corazón; contaré todas las maravillas que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho.
es.R: Le daré gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con todo mi corazón. Contaré todas las cosas asombrosas que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho.

decisions.choice: wonders: God's marvelous deeds
decisions.reason: The word (nifla'ot) is used for God's acts that are beyond human power, above all his saving acts (Exodus 3:20; Psalm 78:4).

decisions.choice: the LORD ... your wonders: speaking of God, then to him
decisions.reason: The psalmist begins by speaking about the LORD and turns at once to speak to him.

decisions.choice: with all my heart: wholeheartedly
decisions.reason: The heart is the whole inner person; thanks "with all my heart" holds nothing back.

source.text: אֶשְׂמְחָ֣ה וְאֶעֶלְצָ֣ה בָ֑ךְ אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֣ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: I will rejoice and exult in you; I will sing praise [to] your name, Most High.

en.L: I will be glad and exult in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; I will sing praise to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, Most High.
en.B: I will be glad and celebrate because of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; I will sing praises to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, Most High.
en.R: I will be happy and full of joy because of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. I will sing praises to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, the God who is above all.

fr.L: Je me réjouirai et j’exulterai en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; je chanterai {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, Très-Haut.
fr.B: Je serai dans la joie et la fête à cause de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; je chanterai la louange de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, Très-Haut.
fr.R: Je serai heureux et plein de joie grâce à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Je chanterai pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, le Dieu qui est au-dessus de tout.

sw.L: Nitafurahi na kushangilia ndani {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; nitaliimbia sifa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, Ee Aliye Juu Kabisa.
sw.B: Nitafurahi na kusherehekea kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; nitaliimbia jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} sifa, Ee Aliye Juu Kabisa.
sw.R: Nitakuwa na furaha na shangwe tele kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}. Nitakuimbia {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} sifa, Mungu uliye juu ya wote.

es.L: Me alegraré y me regocijaré en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; cantaré alabanzas a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, Altísimo.
es.B: Me alegraré y haré fiesta por {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; cantaré alabanzas a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, oh Altísimo.
es.R: Estaré feliz y lleno de alegría gracias a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Cantaré alabanzas para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, el Dios que está por encima de todo.

decisions.choice: Most High: God above all
decisions.reason: As in 7:18, a title of God as ruler over all.

decisions.choice: your name: God as he is known
decisions.reason: As in 5:12.

decisions.choice: to you, the God who is above all
decisions.reason: Readable says what the name and the title mean (m1, m2; compare 7:18).

source.text: בְּשׁוּב־אוֹיְבַ֥י אָח֑וֹר יִכָּשְׁל֥וּ וְ֝יֹאבְד֗וּ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish from before you.

en.L: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish before {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face.
en.B: When my enemies turn and retreat, they stumble and are destroyed in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} presence.
en.R: When my enemies run away, they trip and fall and die because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are there.

fr.L: Quand mes ennemis reculent, ils trébuchent et périssent devant {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face.
fr.B: Quand mes ennemis font demi-tour et battent en retraite, ils trébuchent et sont anéantis devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Quand mes ennemis s’enfuient, ils trébuchent, tombent et meurent parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es là.

sw.L: Adui zangu wanaporudi nyuma, wanajikwaa na kuangamia mbele ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Adui zangu wanapogeuka na kurudi nyuma, wanajikwaa na kuangamizwa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Adui zangu wanapokimbia, wanajikwaa, wanaanguka na kufa kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} upo.

es.L: Cuando mis enemigos retroceden, tropiezan y perecen delante de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro.
es.B: Cuando mis enemigos se vuelven y huyen, tropiezan y son destruidos en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} presencia.
es.R: Cuando mis enemigos huyen, tropiezan, caen y mueren porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} estás allí.

decisions.choice: before your face: at your presence, because of you
decisions.reason: The phrase (mippene) means both "from before" and "because of": the enemies fall when the LORD appears.

decisions.choice: When my enemies turn back: a victory already seen
decisions.reason: The verse gives the reason for the thanks of verses 2-3: the LORD has turned back the enemies. Verse 5 says why.

source.text: כִּֽי־עָ֭שִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י וְדִינִ֑י יָשַׁ֥בְתָּ לְ֝כִסֵּ֗א שׁוֹפֵ֥ט צֶֽדֶק׃

records.literal_gloss: For you have done my justice and my cause; you have sat on a throne, judging righteousness.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have upheld my right and my cause; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have sat on [the] throne, judging [in] righteousness.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have taken up my case and given me justice; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} sat on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} throne as a judge who does what is right.
en.R: You have judged my case fairly. You sat on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} throne and judged rightly.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as soutenu mon droit et ma cause ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}es assis sur [le] trône, jugeant [avec] justice.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as pris en main ma cause et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as rendu justice ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as siégé sur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} trône en juge qui fait ce qui est juste.
fr.R: Tu as jugé ma cause avec équité. Tu as siégé sur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} trône et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as bien jugé.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umeitetea haki yangu na shauri langu; umeketi kitini mwa enzi, ukihukumu kwa haki.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umeichukua kesi yangu na kunipa haki; uliketi kwenye kiti {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}} cha enzi kama mwamuzi anayetenda haki.
sw.R: Umeiamua kesi yangu kwa haki. Uliketi kwenye kiti {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}} cha enzi na kuhukumu kwa haki.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has defendido mi derecho y mi causa; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} has sentado en [el] trono, juzgando [con] justicia.
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has tomado mi caso y me has hecho justicia; {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} sentaste en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} trono como un juez que hace lo que es justo.
es.R: Tú juzgaste mi caso con justicia. Te sentaste en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} trono y juzgaste con rectitud.

decisions.choice: my justice and my cause: my case in court
decisions.reason: Both words (mishpat, din) belong to the law court: God has heard the psalmist's case and ruled in his favor.

decisions.choice: judging in righteousness: a righteous judge
decisions.reason: As in 7:12, God is a judge who rules by what is right.

source.text: גָּעַ֣רְתָּ ג֭וֹיִם אִבַּ֣דְתָּ רָשָׁ֑ע שְׁמָ֥ם מָ֝חִ֗יתָ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: You have rebuked nations; you have destroyed [the] wicked; their name you have wiped out forever and ever.

en.L: You have rebuked nations; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have destroyed [the] wicked; their name {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have wiped out forever and ever.
en.B: You have rebuked the nations and brought the wicked to ruin; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have wiped their name away for all time.
en.R: You have spoken sharply against the nations and destroyed wicked people. No one will ever remember their names again.

fr.L: Tu as réprimandé [les] nations ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait périr [le] méchant ; leur nom, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as effacé pour toujours et à jamais.
fr.B: Tu as réprimandé les nations et ruiné le méchant ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as effacé leur nom pour toujours.
fr.R: Tu as parlé durement aux nations et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as détruit les méchants. Plus personne ne se souviendra jamais de leur nom.

sw.L: Umeyakemea mataifa; umemwangamiza mwovu; jina lao umelifuta milele na milele.
sw.B: Umeyakemea mataifa na kuwaangamiza waovu; umelifuta jina lao kwa nyakati zote.
sw.R: Umeyakaripia mataifa na kuwaangamiza watu waovu. Hakuna mtu atakayekumbuka majina yao tena.

es.L: Has reprendido a [las] naciones; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has destruido [al] malvado; su nombre {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has borrado para siempre jamás.
es.B: Has reprendido a las naciones y has llevado a la ruina al malvado; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has borrado su nombre para siempre.
es.R: Tú has hablado con dureza contra las naciones y has destruido a los malvados. Nadie volverá a recordar sus nombres.

decisions.choice: rebuked: driven back with a word
decisions.reason: God's rebuke (ga'ar) is a word with power that drives back what it is spoken against (Psalm 104:7).

decisions.choice: wiped out their name: removed all memory of them
decisions.reason: To blot out a name is to leave nothing to remember a people by (Deuteronomy 9:14; 25:19).

decisions.choice: the wicked: a group spoken of as one
decisions.reason: The word is singular, standing for all the wicked; "their name" follows.

decisions.choice: No one will ever remember their names again
alternatives: you have wiped out their name
decisions.reason: Readable says what the idiom means (m2).

source.text: הָֽאוֹיֵ֨ב׀תַּ֥מּוּ חֳרָב֗וֹת לָ֫נֶ֥צַח וְעָרִ֥ים נָתַ֑שְׁתָּ אָבַ֖ד זִכְרָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: The enemy: they have come to an end, ruins forever; and cities you have uprooted; their memory has perished, they.

en.L: The enemy: they have come to an end, ruins forever; and cities {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have uprooted; their memory has perished, theirs.
en.B: The enemy is finished, left in ruins forever; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have torn up their cities by the roots, and no one remembers them now.
en.R: The enemy is gone, ruined forever. You destroyed their cities, and they have been completely forgotten.

fr.L: L’ennemi : ils sont finis, ruines pour toujours ; et [des] villes, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [les] as déracinées ; leur souvenir a péri, le leur.
fr.B: L’ennemi est anéanti, en ruine pour toujours ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as arraché leurs villes jusqu’aux racines, et personne ne se souvient plus d’eux.
fr.R: L’ennemi a disparu, ruiné pour toujours. Tu as détruit leurs villes, et on les a complètement oubliés.

sw.L: Adui: wamefikia mwisho, magofu milele; na miji umeing'oa; kumbukumbu lao limepotea, lao.
sw.B: Adui amekwisha, ameachwa magofu milele; umeing'oa miji yao kwa mizizi, na hakuna anayewakumbuka sasa.
sw.R: Adui ametoweka, ameharibika milele. Uliiharibu miji yao, nao wamesahauliwa kabisa.

es.L: El enemigo: han llegado a su fin, ruinas para siempre; y ciudades {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has arrancado; su memoria ha perecido, la de ellos.
es.B: El enemigo está acabado, en ruinas para siempre; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has arrancado de raíz sus ciudades, y ya nadie se acuerda de ellos.
es.R: El enemigo ya no existe; quedó arruinado para siempre. Tú destruiste sus ciudades, y han sido olvidados por completo.

decisions.choice: The enemy: they have come to an end: a broken, emphatic sentence
alternatives: their memory has perished; they ... (joined to verse 8)
decisions.reason: The verse is hard to construe. "The enemy" stands first as the topic, and the pronoun "they" at the end stresses that it is their memory that is gone. Some join that pronoun to verse 8: "they perish, but the LORD sits enthroned".

decisions.choice: uprooted: torn up by the roots
decisions.reason: The verb (natash) is used of pulling up a plant by its roots (Jeremiah 1:10); the cities are destroyed so they cannot grow again.

source.text: וַֽ֭יהוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם יֵשֵׁ֑ב כּוֹנֵ֖ן לַמִּשְׁפָּ֣ט כִּסְאֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: But YHWH forever sits [enthroned]; he has established for judgment his throne.

en.L: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sits [enthroned] forever; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has established {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} throne for judgment.
en.B: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} remains on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} throne forever; it is a throne {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has set up to judge from.
en.R: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will always be king. He has set up {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} throne so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} can judge.

fr.L: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} siège pour toujours ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a établi {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône pour le jugement.
fr.B: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} demeure sur {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône pour toujours ; c’est un trône qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dressé pour juger.
fr.R: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera toujours roi. Il a installé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône pour pouvoir juger.

sw.L: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anaketi [katika enzi] milele; amekiweka imara kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha enzi kwa ajili ya hukumu.
sw.B: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anabaki kwenye kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha enzi milele; ni kiti alichokiweka ili ahukumu kutoka hapo.
sw.R: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwa mfalme daima. Ameweka kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha enzi ili aweze kuhukumu.

es.L: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se sienta [en su trono] para siempre; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha establecido {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono para el juicio.
es.B: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} permanece en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono para siempre; es un trono que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha levantado para juzgar desde allí.
es.R: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} siempre será rey. Él ha establecido {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono para que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} pueda juzgar.

decisions.choice: sits: sits enthroned as king
decisions.reason: As in 2:4, God's sitting is his reign (29:10). The enemies' cities lie in ruins forever (verse 7); the LORD's throne stands forever.

decisions.choice: will always be king
decisions.reason: Readable says what sitting means here (m1).

source.text: וְה֗וּא יִשְׁפֹּֽט־תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק יָדִ֥ין לְ֝אֻמִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he will judge [the] world with righteousness; he will judge peoples with uprightness.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will judge the world with righteousness; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will judge [the] peoples with uprightness.
en.B: He will judge the world rightly and govern the peoples with fairness.
en.R: He will judge everyone in the world fairly. He will be honest when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} judges the nations.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} jugera le monde avec justice ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} jugera [les] peuples avec droiture.
fr.B: Il jugera le monde avec justice et gouvernera les peuples avec équité.
fr.R: Il jugera tous les habitants du monde avec justice. Il sera honnête quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} jugera les nations.

sw.L: Naye atauhukumu ulimwengu kwa haki; atawahukumu watu kwa unyofu.
sw.B: Atauhukumu ulimwengu kwa haki na kuwatawala watu kwa usawa.
sw.R: Atawahukumu watu wote ulimwenguni kwa haki. Atakuwa mwaminifu anapoyahukumu mataifa.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} juzgará al mundo con justicia; juzgará a [los] pueblos con rectitud.
es.B: Él juzgará al mundo con justicia y gobernará a los pueblos con equidad.
es.R: Él juzgará con justicia a todos en el mundo. Será honesto cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} juzgue a las naciones.

decisions.choice: he: he himself
decisions.reason: The pronoun is stated for emphasis: the LORD himself is the judge.

decisions.choice: the world, uprightness: all who live on earth, judged fairly
decisions.reason: The world (tevel) is the inhabited earth. Uprightness (mesharim) is straightness, fairness without favoritism (Psalm 96:10).

decisions.choice: govern
decisions.reason: The second verb (din) is a different word for judging, ruling as a judge; Balanced varies the English to show that.

source.text: וִ֘יהִ֤י יְהוָ֣ה מִשְׂגָּ֣ב לַדָּ֑ךְ מִ֝שְׂגָּ֗ב לְעִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And may YHWH be a high fortress for the oppressed, a high fortress for times of trouble.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be a high fortress for the oppressed, a high fortress in times of trouble.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is a fortress on the heights for those who are crushed, a safe height in times of trouble.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is a safe place for people who are treated badly. He protects them when trouble comes.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera une haute forteresse pour l’opprimé, une haute forteresse aux temps de détresse.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est une forteresse sur les hauteurs pour ceux qu’on écrase, un lieu sûr et élevé aux temps de détresse.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est un lieu sûr pour les gens qu’on maltraite. Il les protège quand vient le malheur.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwa ngome ya juu kwa walioonewa, ngome ya juu nyakati za taabu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni ngome iliyo juu milimani kwa wale wanaopondwa, mahali salama pa juu nyakati za taabu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mahali salama kwa watu wanaotendewa vibaya. Anawalinda taabu inapokuja.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} será una alta fortaleza para el oprimido, una alta fortaleza en tiempos de angustia.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es una fortaleza en las alturas para los que están aplastados, un lugar alto y seguro en tiempos de angustia.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es un lugar seguro para la gente que es maltratada. Él los protege cuando llegan los problemas.

decisions.choice: high fortress: a secure height out of reach
decisions.reason: The word (misgav) is a high place, a stronghold where no enemy can reach (Psalm 18:3).

decisions.choice: the oppressed: those who are crushed
decisions.reason: The word (dak) means crushed, beaten down by others.

decisions.choice: will be: a statement or a wish
decisions.reason: The verb form can be a wish or a statement; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: times of trouble: an unusual phrase, repeated in 10:1
decisions.reason: The word for trouble here (batstsarah) is rare; Psalm 10:1 uses the same phrase, one of the links between the two psalms.

source.text: וְיִבְטְח֣וּ בְ֭ךָ יוֹדְעֵ֣י שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹֽא־עָזַ֖בְתָּ דֹרְשֶׁ֣יךָ יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will trust in you, those knowing your name, for you have not forsaken those seeking you, YHWH.

en.L: And those who know {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name will trust in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have not forsaken those who seek {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Those who know {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name will rely on {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do not desert anyone who comes looking for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: People who know {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will trust {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have never turned away from anyone who comes to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Et ceux qui connaissent {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom se confieront en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’as pas abandonné ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cherchent, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Ceux qui connaissent {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom comptent sur {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’abandonnes aucun de ceux qui viennent {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} chercher, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Les gens qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} connaissent {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} font confiance. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, jamais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}es détourné de quelqu’un qui vient à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Na wale walijuao jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} watakutumaini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, kwa maana hukuwaacha wale wanaokutafuta, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Wale walijuao jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} watakutegemea, kwa sababu huwaachi wale wanaokuja kukutafuta, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Watu wanaokujua watakutumaini. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hujawahi kumwacha mtu yeyote anayekuja {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}.

es.L: Y los que conocen {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre confiarán en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no has abandonado a los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} buscan, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Los que conocen {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre se apoyarán en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no abandonas a nadie que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} busca, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: La gente que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} conoce confiará en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} nunca le has dado la espalda a nadie que viene a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

decisions.choice: know your name: know who God is
decisions.reason: To know the LORD's name is to know him as he has shown himself to be (Exodus 34:5-7; compare 5:12).

decisions.choice: those who seek you: those who turn to God
decisions.reason: To seek (darash) God is to turn to him in prayer and worship (Deuteronomy 4:29). Verse 13 uses the same verb for God "seeking" bloodshed.

decisions.choice: People who know you
decisions.reason: Readable says what knowing the name means (m1).

source.text: זַמְּר֗וּ לַ֭יהוָה יֹשֵׁ֣ב צִיּ֑וֹן הַגִּ֥ידוּ בָ֝עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִֽילוֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Sing praises to YHWH, who dwells [in] Zion; declare among the peoples his deeds.

en.L: Sing praises to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who dwells [in] Zion; declare among the peoples {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} deeds.
en.B: Make music to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, whose throne is in Zion! Announce {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} deeds among the peoples.
en.R: Sing praise to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who rules from Zion! Tell people everywhere what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done.

fr.L: Chantez pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui habite [à] Sion ; annoncez parmi les peuples {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} actions.
fr.B: Jouez pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui siège à Sion ! Proclamez {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} hauts faits parmi les peuples.
fr.R: Chantez la louange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qui règne depuis Sion ! Dites aux gens de partout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait.

sw.L: Mwimbieni sifa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akaaye Sayuni; tangazeni kati ya watu matendo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Mpigieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} muziki, ambaye kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha enzi kiko Sayuni! Tangazeni matendo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kati ya watu.
sw.R: Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sifa, anayetawala kutoka Sayuni! Waambieni watu kila mahali yale aliyoyatenda.

es.L: {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} alabanzas {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, que habita [en] Sion; {{plural_you:proclamen|proclamad}} entre los pueblos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} hechos.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} música {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, que tiene {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono en Sion! {{plural_you:Anuncien|Anunciad}} entre los pueblos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} obras.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} alabanzas {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, que reina desde Sion! {{plural_you:Cuéntenle|Contad}} a la gente de todas partes lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho.

decisions.choice: dwells in Zion: sits enthroned in Zion
decisions.reason: The verb (yashav) is the one used in verse 8 for sitting enthroned. Zion is where the LORD has chosen to dwell (2:6; 132:13).

decisions.choice: among the peoples: God's deeds told to every nation
decisions.reason: The praise of Israel's God is to be heard among all peoples (Psalm 96:3).

decisions.choice: whose throne is in Zion (B); who rules from Zion (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable bring out the throne (m1).

source.text: כִּֽי־דֹרֵ֣שׁ דָּ֭מִים אוֹתָ֣ם זָכָ֑ר לֹֽא־שָׁ֝כַ֗ח צַעֲקַ֥ת עֲנָוִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: For [the] one seeking bloodshed remembers them; he has not forgotten [the] cry of [the] afflicted.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} who avenges blood remembers them; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has not forgotten the cry of the afflicted.
en.B: For the God who calls murderers to account remembers the victims; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has not overlooked the cry of those who suffer.
en.R: God makes murderers pay for what they have done. He remembers those who suffer. He does not forget them when they cry out.

fr.L: Car le vengeur du sang se souvient d’eux ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’a pas oublié le cri des humbles.
fr.B: Car le Dieu qui demande compte du sang versé se souvient des victimes ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’a pas négligé le cri des humbles.
fr.R: Dieu fait payer les meurtriers pour ce qu’ils ont fait. Il se souvient de ceux qui souffrent. Il ne les oublie pas quand ils crient vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alipizaye damu anawakumbuka; hakusahau kilio cha wanyonge.
sw.B: Kwa maana Mungu anayewawajibisha wauaji anawakumbuka walioonewa; hajapuuza kilio cha wale wanaoteseka.
sw.R: Mungu huwalipiza wauaji kwa yale waliyoyatenda. Huwakumbuka wanaoteseka. Hawasahau wanapolia.

es.L: Porque el que venga la sangre se acuerda de ellos; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} no ha olvidado el clamor de los afligidos.
es.B: Porque el Dios que pide cuentas a los asesinos se acuerda de las víctimas; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} no ha pasado por alto el clamor de los que sufren.
es.R: Dios hace pagar a los asesinos por lo que han hecho. Él se acuerda de los que sufren. No se olvida de ellos cuando claman.

decisions.choice: the one who seeks bloodshed: God, who calls murderers to account
decisions.reason: To "seek" blood (darash damim) is to demand payment for a life taken, as God says in Genesis 9:5, "I will require your lifeblood".

decisions.choice: them: the afflicted
decisions.reason: "Them" points ahead to the afflicted, whose blood and cries God remembers.

decisions.choice: the afflicted: the word as read, not as written
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text writes one word ("the afflicted", 'aniyyim) and its notes say to read another ("the humble", 'anavim), or the reverse; the two words are close in form and meaning, both used of the poor who depend on God. The words follow the form to be read.

decisions.choice: the God who calls murderers to account (B); God makes murderers pay (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means (m1).

decisions.choice: "les humbles" for the afflicted (Literal, Balanced), "ceux qui souffrent" at Readable, for this block of psalms; "le pauvre", "l'indigent" for the other words of that group
decisions.reason: Following the terms note for Psalms: the afflicted are the poor and lowly who suffer at others' hands. "Humble" keeps that low place in society; Readable says plainly that they suffer, as the English does.

source.text: חָֽנְנֵ֬נִי יְהוָ֗ה רְאֵ֣ה עָ֭נְיִי מִשֹּׂנְאָ֑י מְ֝רוֹמְמִ֗י מִשַּׁ֥עֲרֵי מָֽוֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: Be gracious to me, YHWH; see my affliction from those who hate me, [you who] lift me up from [the] gates of death,

en.L: Be gracious to me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}; see my affliction from those who hate me, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} who lift me up from the gates of death,
en.B: Show me grace, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}! See how my enemies make me suffer, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} who lift me up from the gates of death,
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, be kind to me! See how my enemies hurt me. You can bring me back from the edge of death.

fr.L: Fais-moi grâce, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; vois mon affliction [venant] de ceux qui me haïssent, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui me relèves des portes de la mort,
fr.B: Fais-moi grâce, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Vois comme mes ennemis me font souffrir, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui me relèves des portes de la mort,
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, sois bon pour moi ! Vois comme mes ennemis me font du mal. Tu peux me ramener du bord de la mort.

sw.L: Unifanyie neema, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; uyaone mateso yangu kutoka kwa wanaonichukia, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uniinuaye kutoka malango ya mauti,
sw.B: Unihurumie, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Uone jinsi adui zangu wanavyonitesa, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unayeniinua kutoka malango ya mauti,
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unionee huruma! Uone jinsi adui zangu wanavyoniumiza. Wewe unaweza kunirudisha kutoka ukingoni mwa kifo.

es.L: Ten piedad de mí, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; mira mi aflicción [causada] por los que me odian, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} que me levantas de las puertas de la muerte,
es.B: ¡Muéstrame {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gracia, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! Mira cómo me hacen sufrir mis enemigos, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} que me levantas de las puertas de la muerte,
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡sé bondadoso conmigo! Mira cómo me hacen daño mis enemigos. Tú puedes traerme de vuelta del borde de la muerte.

decisions.choice: the gates of death: the entrance to the place of the dead
decisions.reason: Death and Sheol are pictured as a city with gates (Job 38:17; Isaiah 38:10). Verse 15 sets them against the gates of Zion.

decisions.choice: you who lift me up: a description of God
decisions.reason: The participle describes God by what he does; the sentence runs on into verse 15, so this verse ends with a comma.

decisions.choice: the edge of death
decisions.reason: Readable says what the gates of death are (m1).

source.text: לְמַ֥עַן אֲסַפְּרָ֗ה כָּֽל־תְּהִלָּ֫תֶ֥יךָ בְּשַֽׁעֲרֵ֥י בַת־צִיּ֑וֹן אָ֝גִ֗ילָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: so that I may recount all your praises in [the] gates of [the] daughter of Zion; I will rejoice in your salvation.

en.L: so that I may recount all {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} praises in the gates of the daughter of Zion; I will rejoice in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} salvation.
en.B: so that in the gates of the city of Zion I may tell all the reasons {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are praised, and be glad that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} saved me.
en.R: Then I will tell everyone in Jerusalem why {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} deserve praise. I will be glad because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} saved me.

fr.L: afin que je raconte toutes {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} louanges aux portes de la fille de Sion ; je me réjouirai de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} salut.
fr.B: afin qu’aux portes de la ville de Sion je dise toutes les raisons de {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louer, et que je me réjouisse de ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as sauvé.
fr.R: Alors je dirai à tous les habitants de Jérusalem pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mérites d’être loué. Je serai heureux parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as sauvé.

sw.L: ili nisimulie sifa {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zote katika malango ya binti Sayuni; nitaufurahia wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: ili katika malango ya mji wa Sayuni niseme sababu zote unazosifiwa, na kufurahi kwamba umeniokoa.
sw.R: Ndipo nitawaambia watu wote wa Yerusalemu kwa nini unastahili kusifiwa. Nitafurahi kwa sababu umeniokoa.

es.L: para que yo cuente todas {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} alabanzas en las puertas de la hija de Sion; me alegraré en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} salvación.
es.B: para que en las puertas de la ciudad de Sion cuente todos los motivos por los que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres alabado, y me alegre de que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me hayas salvado.
es.R: Entonces contaré a todos en Jerusalén por qué {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} mereces alabanza. Estaré feliz porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me salvaste.

decisions.choice: the daughter of Zion: Jerusalem and its people
decisions.reason: The city is pictured as a daughter (Isaiah 1:8). Its gates were the public squares where people met (Ruth 4:1); there the psalmist will praise God in front of all.

decisions.choice: your praises: the deeds that are your praise
decisions.reason: The praises (tehillot) are the deeds for which God is praised (78:4).

decisions.choice: salvation: rescue
decisions.reason: As in 3:3 and 3:9.

decisions.choice: the city of Zion (B); Jerusalem (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the phrase means (m1).

source.text: טָבְע֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם בְּשַׁ֣חַת עָשׂ֑וּ בְּרֶֽשֶׁת־ז֥וּ טָ֝מָ֗נוּ נִלְכְּדָ֥ה רַגְלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Nations have sunk in [the] pit they made; in [the] net which they hid their foot has been caught.

en.L: [The] nations have sunk into the pit they made; in the net which they hid their own foot is caught.
en.B: The nations have sunk down into the very pit they dug; the net they hid has snared their own feet.
en.R: The nations dug a hole to trap others, but they fell into it themselves. They hid a net, but their own feet got caught in it.

fr.L: [Les] nations ont sombré dans la fosse qu’elles ont faite ; dans le filet qu’elles ont caché, leur propre pied s’est pris.
fr.B: Les nations se sont enfoncées dans la fosse même qu’elles avaient creusée ; le filet qu’elles avaient caché a pris leurs propres pieds.
fr.R: Les nations ont creusé un trou pour piéger les autres, mais elles y sont tombées elles-mêmes. Elles ont caché un filet, mais leurs propres pieds s’y sont pris.

sw.L: Mataifa yamezama katika shimo walilolifanya; katika wavu walioficha mguu wao wenyewe umenaswa.
sw.B: Mataifa yamezama ndani ya shimo lile lile walilolichimba; wavu walioutega kwa siri umeinasa miguu yao wenyewe.
sw.R: Mataifa yalichimba shimo ili kuwanasa wengine, lakini yakaanguka ndani yake yenyewe. Yaliuficha wavu, lakini miguu yao wenyewe ikanaswa ndani yake.

es.L: Se han hundido [las] naciones en la fosa que hicieron; en la red que escondieron quedó atrapado su propio pie.
es.B: Las naciones se han hundido en la misma fosa que cavaron; la red que escondieron ha atrapado sus propios pies.
es.R: Las naciones cavaron un hoyo para atrapar a otros, pero ellas mismas cayeron en él. Escondieron una red, pero sus propios pies quedaron enredados en ella.

decisions.choice: pit and net: traps for animals
decisions.reason: As in 7:16, the trap meant for others catches the one who set it.

decisions.choice: sunk: sunk down, as into mud
decisions.reason: The verb (tava') is used of sinking into mud or deep water (Jeremiah 38:6).

source.text: נ֤וֹדַ֨ע׀יְהוָה֮ מִשְׁפָּ֪ט עָ֫שָׂ֥ה בְּפֹ֣עַל כַּ֭פָּיו נוֹקֵ֣שׁ רָשָׁ֑ע הִגָּי֥וֹן סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH has made himself known; judgment he has done, snaring [the] wicked by [the] work of his palms. Higgaion. Selah.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has made {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} known; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done justice, snaring [the] wicked by the work of their own palms. Higgaion. Selah
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has made {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} known by doing justice: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} snares the wicked in the work of their own hands. Higgaion. Selah
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has shown who {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is by judging fairly. He catches wicked people in their own traps. Higgaion. Selah

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:s’|S’}}est fait connaître ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait justice, prenant au piège [le] méchant par l’œuvre de ses propres paumes. Higgaïon. Sélah
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:s’|S’}}est fait connaître en rendant justice : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prend le méchant au piège de ce que ses propres mains ont fait. Higgaïon. Sélah
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a montré qui {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est en jugeant avec justice. Il prend les méchants dans leurs propres pièges. Higgaïon. Sélah

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amejijulisha; ametenda hukumu, akimnasa mwovu kwa kazi ya viganja vyake mwenyewe. Higayoni. Sela
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amejijulisha kwa kutenda haki: anawanasa waovu katika kazi ya mikono yao wenyewe. Higayoni. Sela
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameonyesha jinsi alivyo kwa kuhukumu kwa haki. Anawanasa watu waovu katika mitego yao wenyewe. Higayoni. Sela

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se ha dado a conocer; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho justicia, atrapando [al] malvado en la obra de sus propias palmas. Higaión. Selah
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se ha dado a conocer haciendo justicia: {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} atrapa a los malvados en la obra de sus propias manos. Higaión. Selah
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha mostrado quién es {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} juzgando con justicia. Atrapa a los malvados en sus propias trampas. Higaión. Selah

decisions.choice: snaring the wicked by the work of their own hands
alternatives: the wicked is snared by the work of his own hands
decisions.reason: The word is a participle, "snaring", with the LORD as subject; with other vowels it reads "the wicked is snared". Either way the hands are the wicked person's own, as in verse 16: the trap they made catches them.

decisions.choice: Higgaion: a musical direction
decisions.reason: The word (higgayon) comes from the verb for murmuring (hagah, 1:2). Psalm 92:4 uses it of the sound of a lyre. Here, next to Selah, it is probably a direction for the music; its exact sense is unknown, so every level keeps it.

decisions.choice: has made himself known: shown who he is
decisions.reason: The LORD makes himself known by what he does, here by judging rightly.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: "Higgaïon" kept as a name at every level
decisions.reason: It is a musical direction whose exact sense is lost (m2); French keeps it as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Higayoni" kept as it is, before "Sela", at every level
alternatives: translating it as "kwa sauti ya chini" (softly)
decisions.reason: Higgaion is a musical direction whose exact sense is lost (m2); like Sela, it is kept as a word rather than guessed at.

decisions.choice: Higaión
decisions.reason: The Hebrew higgaion is probably a direction for the music, perhaps a quiet or resounding interlude; its exact sense is not known. Spanish keeps the word in its Spanish form, as the English keeps it.

source.text: יָשׁ֣וּבוּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים לִשְׁא֑וֹלָה כָּל־גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם שְׁכֵחֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] wicked will return to Sheol, all nations forgetting God.

en.L: [The] wicked will turn back to Sheol, all [the] nations that forget God.
en.B: The wicked will go back down to Sheol, every nation that forgets God.
en.R: Wicked people will go to the place of the dead. So will every nation that forgets God.

fr.L: [Les] méchants retourneront au Shéol, toutes [les] nations qui oublient Dieu.
fr.B: Les méchants redescendront au séjour des morts, toutes les nations qui oublient Dieu.
fr.R: Les méchants iront au séjour des morts. Et toutes les nations qui oublient Dieu iront aussi.

sw.L: Waovu watarudi Kuzimu, mataifa yote yanayomsahau Mungu.
sw.B: Waovu watashuka tena Kuzimu, kila taifa linalomsahau Mungu.
sw.R: Watu waovu wataenda Kuzimu. Vivyo hivyo kila taifa linalomsahau Mungu.

es.L: Los malvados volverán al Seol, todas [las] naciones que se olvidan de Dios.
es.B: Los malvados bajarán de nuevo al lugar de los muertos, toda nación que se olvida de Dios.
es.R: Los malvados irán al lugar de los muertos. Lo mismo pasará con toda nación que se olvida de Dios.

decisions.choice: turn back to Sheol: return to the dead
decisions.reason: The verb (shuv) is the one used in verse 4, where the enemies "turn back"; here they turn back all the way to Sheol, the place of the dead (6:6).

decisions.choice: nations that forget God: forgetting him and forgotten
decisions.reason: To forget God is to live as if he did not matter (Deuteronomy 8:19). The nations forget God; God does not forget the afflicted (verses 13, 19).

decisions.choice: the place of the dead
decisions.reason: As in 6:6.

source.text: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א לָ֭נֶצַח יִשָּׁכַ֣ח אֶבְי֑וֹן תִּקְוַ֥ת עֲ֝נִיִּ֗ים תֹּאבַ֥ד לָעַֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: For not forever will [the] needy be forgotten; [the] hope of [the] afflicted [will not] perish forever.

en.L: For not forever will the needy be forgotten; the hope of the afflicted [will not] perish forever.
en.B: For the needy will not always be forgotten, nor will the hope of the poor be lost forever.
en.R: God will not forget poor people forever. People in need will not always be without hope.

fr.L: Car pas pour toujours l’indigent ne sera oublié ; l’espérance des humbles ne périra [pas] pour toujours.
fr.B: Car l’indigent ne sera pas toujours oublié, et l’espoir des pauvres ne sera pas perdu à jamais.
fr.R: Dieu n’oubliera pas les pauvres pour toujours. Les gens dans le besoin ne resteront pas toujours sans espoir.

sw.L: Kwa maana si milele mhitaji atasahauliwa; tumaini la wanyonge [halitapotea] milele.
sw.B: Kwa maana mhitaji hatasahauliwa siku zote, wala tumaini la maskini halitapotea milele.
sw.R: Mungu hatawasahau maskini milele. Watu wenye shida hawatakosa tumaini siku zote.

es.L: Porque no para siempre será olvidado el necesitado; la esperanza de los afligidos [no] perecerá para siempre.
es.B: Porque el necesitado no será olvidado siempre, ni la esperanza del pobre se perderá para siempre.
es.R: Dios no se olvidará para siempre de los pobres. La gente necesitada no estará siempre sin esperanza.

decisions.choice: not ... perish: one "not" for both lines
decisions.reason: The word "not" at the start governs both lines, as often in Hebrew poetry.

decisions.choice: the needy: the poor who have no one to help them
decisions.reason: The needy ('evyon) are the poor and powerless (Deuteronomy 15:11).

decisions.choice: the afflicted: the word as read, not as written
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text writes one word ("the afflicted", 'aniyyim) and its notes say to read another ("the humble", 'anavim), or the reverse; the two words are close in form and meaning, both used of the poor who depend on God. The words follow the form to be read.

decisions.choice: God will not forget
decisions.reason: Readable names who remembers them, as verses 13 and 18 do.

decisions.choice: "mhitaji" for the needy (ʾevyon), "mnyonge" for the afflicted (ʿani) and "maskini" for the poor, through the Psalms
decisions.reason: The Psalms use several words for people who are poor, crushed and without help. Keeping three Swahili words lets readers see the pairs in parallel lines; Balanced follows the English "poor" here.

source.text: קוּמָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אַל־יָעֹ֣ז אֱנ֑וֹשׁ יִשָּׁפְט֥וּ ג֝וֹיִ֗ם עַל־פָּנֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Arise, YHWH; let not man prevail; let nations be judged before your face.

en.L: Arise, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}; let not {{gender:mortals|man}} prevail; let [the] nations be judged before {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face.
en.B: Rise up, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}! Do not let mere humans win. Bring the nations to judgment before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: Get up, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}! Do not let mere humans win. Judge the nations in front of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Lève-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; que {{gender:le mortel|l’homme}} ne l’emporte pas ; que [les] nations soient jugées devant {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face.
fr.B: Debout, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Ne laisse pas de simples humains l’emporter. Fais comparaître les nations devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Lève-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Ne laisse pas de simples humains gagner. Juge les nations devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Inuka, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; mwanadamu asishinde; mataifa yahukumiwe mbele ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Simama, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Usiwaache wanadamu tu washinde. Uyalete mataifa hukumuni mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Amka, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Usiwaache wanadamu tu washinde. Uyahukumu mataifa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

es.L: Levántate, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; no prevalezca {{gender:el mortal|el hombre}}; sean juzgadas [las] naciones delante de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro.
es.B: ¡Álzate, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! No dejes que los simples humanos triunfen. Lleva a las naciones a juicio delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: ¡Levántate, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! No dejes que ganen los que solo son humanos. Juzga a las naciones delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

decisions.choice: Arise, LORD
decisions.reason: As in 3:8 and 7:7 (Numbers 10:35).

decisions.choice: man: mere mortals
decisions.reason: The word ('enosh) is the one of 8:5, used for human weakness. However strong the nations seem, they are only human (verse 21).

decisions.choice: mortals, with "man" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The word means humankind (m2); Balanced and Readable say "humans".

decisions.choice: Rise up (B); Get up (R)
decisions.reason: As in 3:8.

source.text: שִׁ֘יתָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה׀מוֹרָ֗ה לָ֫הֶ֥ם יֵדְע֥וּ גוֹיִ֑ם אֱנ֖וֹשׁ הֵ֣מָּה סֶּֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Put, YHWH, terror on them; let nations know they [are] mortals. Selah.

en.L: Put terror on them, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}; let [the] nations know they [are] {{gender:mortals|men}}. Selah
en.B: Fill them with fear, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and let the nations find out they are nothing but human. Selah
en.R: Make them afraid, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}. Let the nations learn that they are only people. Selah

fr.L: Mets sur eux la terreur, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; que [les] nations sachent qu’elles [sont] {{gender:des mortels|des hommes}}. Sélah
fr.B: Remplis-les de crainte, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et que les nations découvrent qu’elles ne sont que des humains. Sélah
fr.R: Fais-leur peur, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Que les nations apprennent qu’elles ne sont que des humains. Sélah

sw.L: Uwatie hofu, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; mataifa yajue kwamba [wao ni] binadamu tu. Sela
sw.B: Uwajaze hofu, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na mataifa yatambue kwamba wao si kitu ila wanadamu. Sela
sw.R: Uwatie hofu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Mataifa yajifunze kwamba wao ni watu tu. Sela

es.L: Pon terror sobre ellos, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; sepan [las] naciones que [son] {{gender:mortales|hombres}}. Selah
es.B: Llénalos de miedo, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y que las naciones descubran que no son más que humanos. Selah
es.R: Haz que tengan miedo, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Que las naciones aprendan que solo son personas. Selah

decisions.choice: terror: fear, dread
decisions.reason: The word (morah) means fear. With a small change of vowels it could be "teacher", and the ancient Greek translation has "lawgiver".

decisions.choice: mortals: only human
decisions.reason: The word ('enosh) of verse 20 again: the nations must learn they are not gods.

decisions.choice: mortals, with "men" as the alternative
decisions.reason: As in verse 20.
